rubrics.intent_basis: Border glyphs were extracted from Style.borderStyle into many sibling fields.
rubrics.baseline_defect: Style stores each Border glyph separately while setters and getters manually spread and reassemble the same value.
rubrics.criterion: Keep the configured border glyphs as a coherent value across Style storage, mutation, and retrieval.
rubrics.acceptance: Changing a Border member has one coherent ownership path through set and get, with the existing public Border behavior intact. Equivalent invariant-owning operations or encapsulated indexed storage are valid; a specific record layout, removal of every scalar, or a class per group is not required. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Renaming or wrapping the same independently maintained association without centralizing its invariant is insufficient. Encapsulated parallel storage with cohesive construction, transformation and access can qualify.

rubrics.intent_basis: The second stage added raw-empty flags and a direct copy path around the split glyph fields.
rubrics.baseline_defect: set substitutes spaces into glyph fields, records four raw-empty flags, and get and setFrom each independently interpret or copy that dual representation.
rubrics.criterion: Give raw configured border values and any effective rendering defaults one consistent owner across setting, inheritance, and querying.
rubrics.acceptance: Explicit empty values, explicit spaces, and property presence retain their distinct meanings without independent flags or copy rules drifting across methods. Equivalent invariant-owning operations or encapsulated indexed storage are valid; a specific record layout, removal of every scalar, or a class per group is not required. Raw storage with defaults computed on demand is valid; neither empty flags nor normalized storage is mandatory. Keep empty, literal-space and unset meanings distinct, including raw getters and implicit border-side decisions. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Renaming or wrapping the same independently maintained association without centralizing its invariant is insufficient. Encapsulated parallel storage with cohesive construction, transformation and access can qualify.

rubrics.baseline_defect: flattenRecursive stores parent-relative coordinates plus parent origins; Bounds, Draw, and Hit each reconstruct absolute rectangles or translate hit coordinates independently.
rubrics.criterion: Coordinate captured layer geometry through the producer and all bounds, drawing, and hit consumers using one consistent placement meaning.

rubrics.intent_basis: The resizer now hands separate content widths and columnFrames to Table rendering.
rubrics.baseline_defect: resizing.go exports columnXPaddings to Table.columnFrames, and table.go re-adds them independently for borders, headers, cells, row separators, and truncation.
rubrics.criterion: Coordinate the column width result between the resizer and every table renderer through one consistent width contract.

rubrics.intent_basis: Current tables vary cell style by row and column, including horizontal frame and fixed-width settings.
rubrics.baseline_defect: resize accumulates the maximum cell frame by changing columnMaxes by a frame delta and then separately updating columnXPaddings; maxCharCount subtracts that frame while maxTotal treats columnMaxes as already framed.

rubrics.intent_basis: The retry explicitly changes expandRowHeights to consume content widths directly while allocation and render consumers use other width meanings.
rubrics.baseline_defect: expandRowHeights receives a bare width slice whose newly changed unit is external to the wrapping/row-height consumer; its vertical-padding lookup is combined with that implicit horizontal budget.
rubrics.criterion: Make the width-to-row-height handoff express the content budget coherently with the column allocation that produced it.
rubrics.acceptance: Wrapping and nonwrapping/manual-height behavior use the appropriate content budget and existing vertical frame. A focused content-width projection, full-width input with one conversion, or integrated layout computation qualifies. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Only grouping column storage while leaving the row-height consumer to guess the width unit is insufficient.
